C.title: C. Reading Comprehension
intro: Olivia has worked for an international events company for four years. She has organized conferences in several countries, but until this year she had never worked on an event in Japan. Last month, her company sent her to Tokyo to help organize a technology conference.

Before the conference, Olivia had a very busy schedule. She had the hotel staff prepare two large meeting rooms, and she asked a local printing company to print the programs. The final schedule was changed twice, but everything was ready by Friday afternoon. The conference was attended by more than 600 people.

After the event, Olivia stayed in Tokyo for two extra days. She visited several famous sights and tried Japanese food. She especially enjoyed visiting an old temple outside the city. She said the trip was so interesting that she would like to return. Next month, however, she will be working on a new project in Madrid. The project plan has already been approved, but the team still has to finish the budget.
questions: 1. How long has Olivia worked for the events company?
2. Had she worked on an event in Japan before this year?
3. Why did she go to Tokyo?
4. What did she have the hotel staff do?
5. Who printed the conference programs?
6. How many people attended the conference?
7. What did Olivia do after the event?
8. What did she especially enjoy?
9. Where will she be working next month?
10. What has already been approved, and what still needs to be finished?

D.title: D. Listening & Summary
intro: Your teacher will read a passage aloud twice. Listen carefully, then summarize it in your own words. Include the main situation, the problem or important events, and the final result or plan.

E.title: E. Writing Task
intro: Write about a memorable experience you have had. It may be a trip, an event, a restaurant experience, a performance, or another important experience.

Include:
• what the experience was and when it happened
• where it took place and who was with you
• what happened
• what you liked or disliked and why
• whether you would do it again
Use both the present perfect and the simple past where appropriate. Try to use other Level 3 structures and vocabulary.
